title: A working canvas
description: An open, acid-yellow workspace of web and mobile products. Pan between artboards or read everything as a page.
signature: The opening camera glides across oversized lettering into a spatial portfolio; clusters become a keyboard-driven presentation.
holdback: The labelled care recreation is substantial owner-specific material: actual clinic, day and unit controls render the visible chart. It earns more than the surrounding canvas chrome. The artboards do not communicate a necessary spatial relationship, and the existing reading mode demonstrates that the work survives removal of the canvas metaphor. On mobile the giant identity pushes most of the valuable chart below the viewport.
slopCauses: Giant name with trailing full stop consumes the main artboard.
